lines.text: مریخ چون او و افتاب بیست درجه بماند ناپدید شود و چون بیست درجه از افتاب بگذرد پیدا
lines.en: Mars, when it and the Sun remain twenty degrees apart, becomes invisible, and when it passes twenty degrees from the Sun, it appears.

lines.text: شود و چون افتاب از آن نود درجه بگذرد راجع شود و چون افتاب بنود درجه او رسد
lines.en: And when the Sun passes ninety degrees from it, it becomes retrograde, and when the Sun reaches ninety degrees from it,

lines.text: مستقیم شود زهره چون میان آن و افتاب هشت درجه بماند ناپدید شود و چون از افتاب
lines.en: it becomes direct. Venus, when between it and the Sun eight degrees remain, becomes invisible, and when from the Sun

lines.text: هشت درجه بگذرد راجع شود و چون افتاب بچهل و هشت درجه رسد مستقیم شود عطارد چون
lines.en: it passes eight degrees, it becomes retrograde, and when the Sun reaches forty-eight degrees, it becomes direct. Mercury, when

lines.text: میان او و افتاب سیزده درجه شود ناپدید شود و چون سیزده درجه بگذرد پیدا شود و
lines.en: between it and the Sun becomes thirteen degrees, it becomes invisible, and when it passes thirteen degrees, it appears, and

lines.text: چون از افتاب بیست و هفت درجه بگذرد راجع شود و چون افتاب ببیست و هفت
lines.en: when it passes twenty-seven degrees from the Sun, it becomes retrograde, and when the Sun reaches twenty-seven

lines.text: درجه او رسد مستقیم شود و این که گفتیم بمخفف است و در زیج بتحقیق توان دانست
lines.en: degrees from it, it becomes direct. And what we have said is in summary, and in the astronomical tables it can be known with exactness.

lines.text: باب بیست و یکم در بیان خسوف قمر و کسوف شمس بدان که خسوف قمر وقت استقبال بود و کسوف
lines.en: Chapter twenty-one: On the explanation of the lunar eclipse and the solar eclipse. Know that the lunar eclipse is at the time of opposition, and the solar eclipse

lines.text: شمس وقت اجتماع و سبب خسوف قمر آن باشد که ماه مقابل افتاب بود و نزدیک باشد بعقده
lines.en: is at the time of conjunction. And the cause of the lunar eclipse is that the Moon is opposite the Sun and is close to the node

lines.text: راس یا ذنب و ماه را عرض اندک بود پس عقده و میانه زمین که شب از اوست نور افتاب
lines.en: of the Head or Tail, and the Moon has a small latitude. Then the node and the middle of the Earth, from which is the night, cut off the light of the Sun

lines.text: از قمر قطع کند پس بحسب عرض جرم ماه سیاه باشد و خسوف بعد از استقبال بهیچ وقت
lines.en: from the Moon. Then, according to the latitude, the body of the Moon is black. And the eclipse after opposition at no time

lines.text: دیگر نباشد اما کسوف وقت اجتماع باشد نزدیک بود بعقده و قمر را عرض نبود یا اندک
lines.en: else occurs. But the solar eclipse is at the time of conjunction, close to the node, and the Moon has no latitude or a small one.

lines.text: بود پس چون بافتاب پیوندد و جرم ماه حجاب افتاب شود گرفته نماید و در هر شهری تفاوتی
lines.en: Then when it joins the Sun and the body of the Moon becomes a veil for the Sun, it appears eclipsed, and in every city there is a difference.

summary.headline: Planetary Stations and Eclipses
summary.text: Rules for the invisibility, visibility, retrogradation, and direct motion of Mars, Venus, and Mercury by angular distance from the Sun, followed by Chapter Twenty-One’s explanation of lunar and solar eclipses at opposition and conjunction near the lunar nodes.
